title: HSBC Slashes 70% of UK Wealth Advisers to Expand AI Use
summary:
The bank is planning to eliminate half of all management and specialist positions within its UK wealth management business in a restructuring of its operations. Proposed layoffs also target nearly 70% of financial adviser roles, with some affected personnel facing the loss of almost entire teams. HSBC has entered a consultation period for these redundancies, which are described as "deep, wide and brutal."

The cuts come as HSBC expands its use of artificial intelligence to automate advisory and specialist functions. The Financial Times first reported that the bank is shifting toward an AI-driven tool and ecosystem to handle wealth management tasks, which will reduce the need for human staff in its UK division.
